calibration.B77_rule: max coverage with >=30 proposals and observed precision>=.90, tie higher; else1.1
calibration.NLU_rule: max maskedmicroF1, tie higher; one threshold per head; no rare-class tuning
calibration.groups: SHA256 literal publisher group_id parity, measured actual counts; may differ from earlier derived B77 union IDs

features.matched_pooling: 0.5 whole-turn/context-summary +0.5 designer local readout; identical for G and NoEdges; sparse shares same raw pooling

known_limits: Internal exposed publisher TRAIN/fold/shard EVAL; not qualification
Two known contraction cross-split families preserved/disclosed; broader semantic ancestry unknown
Taskmaster24TRAIN/30total closure components are embargo units, not IID
NLU slot-marker leakage: sanitized-domain scores only; controls do not restore raw slot extraction
No bank adaptation, permission, policy values or hidden/live claims
objective: B77 groupCE/log77 +0.5 NLUintent maskedgroupBCE/log2 +0.5 NLUslot maskedgroupBCE/log2 +0.2 Taskmaster group squared-error(normalized512 response hash) +0.0005||weights||^2

optimizer.algorithm: Adam; deterministic shuffled TRAIN rows; exact group/source weight with unbiased minibatch scaling

parity_contract: All EVAL rows plus TRAIN/CAL representative of every B77 class; full logits/probability/threshold parity; full float32 native states retained.
teacher: Separate Kuhn worker; no teacher/cache/download invoked here
